description: Look up the QIE ID, such as yourname.qie, for an address on QIE mainnet (chain 1990): the default QIE ID the owner chose, otherwise the free QIE ID the address holds. When the chain gives no name and the server has the QIE ID API configured, the names the API lists for the address are tried, free QIE IDs first. A name is shown only when it resolves back to the same address through a QIE ID record store published on the QIE explorer. An address with no QIE ID returns status ok with name null. QIE ID is not deployed on testnet (chain 1983), so lookups there return status unresolved. No name is guessed. This tool does not give price, APY, returns, yield, or investment advice and will decline such questions.

network.description: Pinned network. mainnet is chain 1990 and testnet is chain 1983. Defaults to mainnet. A raw chain ID or RPC URL is not accepted.
